nodes.title: Clean CLmax 0.75
nodes.text: Wing section CLmax 0.75 sets every stall number
nodes.basis: EST in MISSION s1 (SIZING-A s2); D-195: S5010 2-D CFD stall 11 deg (Mat Yazik et al., abstract) with CLa 3.74 /rad and alpha0 -0.52 deg gives 0.75, consistent; no measured S5010 CLmax found (airfoiltools unreachable 2026-11-15); the measured stall replaces it before airspeed limits are frozen

nodes.title: Neutral point 40.7 mm aft of LE

nodes.title: 41.6 g of EST cuts are real
nodes.text: Predicted mass <= 1.470 kg (D-208; D-207 1.467; D-205 1.465; D-195 1.46) holds only if the foam (25 kg/m3), printed parts and hardware lump weigh in at their cut values
nodes.basis: BOARD QP-4 s1 and FIXES2 s5: none of the three cuts is weighed; the foam row alone (16.6 g) was the first line; M11 weighs a FOAMULAR 150 block

nodes.title: Printed hub socket walls (2.0 mm, D-196) carry the prop-strike couple
nodes.text: The 0.48 socket margin is a bond margin; the wall hoop check passes the crude ring model only with a 12 mm bearing patch
nodes.basis: D-196, structures/qp5_checks.md s2/s2b: arm-socket wall raised 0.8 -> 2.0 mm over the 12 mm mouth zone, bridge sleeve 1.2 mm (hub 13.1 -> 17.7 g). Ring model (hoop 2F/(pi l t), F 332 N, allowable 20 MPa EST): MS +0.05 at l 12 mm, -0.47 at l 6 mm; sleeve +0.44 / -0.28. Unproven until the bench coupon: print a socket at 2.0 mm, bond a 12 mm tube, load to 1.5 x 332 N

nodes.title: Foam tension 129 kPa and shear 86 kPa
nodes.text: Foam shear and tension allowables are the old 150 / 100 kPa scaled by 103 / 120
nodes.basis: FIXES2 s6: the FOAMULAR 150 data sheet has no tension or shear row (searched 2026-11-15); the 103 kPa compressive value is the data sheet (OC, ASTM D1621)

nodes.title: The M02 pushrod is music wire (ASTM A228) or as strong
nodes.text: The 1.2 mm M02 rod has a bending allowable >= the 1172 MPa the Z-bend leg needs at 1.5 x the 51 N stall force
nodes.basis: D-212 rev 3: RMRC publishes 'steel' only; the A228 constants (S_ut = 2211 / d^0.145 MPa, bending 0.78 S_ut, Shigley Tables 10-4 / 10-6) are RECALLED, not re-read. Receipt test: 77 N along the formed rod, 10 s, no permanent set over 0.2 mm, else A228 wire

nodes.title: Printed PETG 20 MPa in-layer and bearing
nodes.text: Printed PETG (Prusament, R03) carries 20 MPa in the layer plane and in hole bearing
nodes.basis: structures/fea_arm.py ALLOW['petg'] and arm_cup_checks.py PETG_BEAR: EST, no coupon yet; the horn is printed lying flat so its bending and bearing are in the layer plane

nodes.title: Bench thrust stand, one MN2212 + APC 9x4.5MR (M1)
nodes.procedure: Order 1 kit, 16.8 V and 14.9 V supply, 0-100 % in steps: gf, A, rpm; pass fresh >= 780 gf and sag >= 624 gf per motor at the 0.90 cap (bench_analysis.py)

nodes.title: One motor at the 0.90 cap, current and can temperature (M2)
nodes.procedure: One motor at duty 0.90 for 180 s: phase A <= 13 A, can <= 80 C (bench_analysis.py)

nodes.title: Hanging yaw test, arm x1.2, cant 16 deg (M3)
nodes.procedure: Hanging yaw plate at +-0.10 throttle: authority >= 0.35 N m go; 0.30-0.35 go with the 4 m/s card; < 0.30 R2 (BOARD G3)

nodes.title: Elevon coupon E1: K, free play, ring-down, stop, damper over temperature
nodes.procedure: FIXES2 s8 steps 1-7 on a 300 mm wing section with the real elevon, lead strip, caps, damper and ES3054HV at 7.2 V; c >= 7.1e-4 N m s/rad at 25 C, c(50 C) >= 4.0e-4

nodes.title: Elevon horn: rib coupon, stall step, elevon-section torsion coupon, bench stall test (D-212 rev 3, review r3 M-1)
nodes.procedure: (1) horn-rib coupon 36.8 N / 30 s, no crack, no slip, set < 0.5 deg; (2) then 51 N / 5 s, hole elongation <= 0.1 mm, no crack; (3) elevon-section torsion coupon 0.161 N m / 30 s, twist set < 0.5 deg, no debond; (4) bench stall test 51 N / 5 s into the stop (BUILD D5b). >= 3 coupons, lowest governs. A pass replaces the analysis FAIL claims (CL-A-HORN-RIB-FOAM-*, CL-A-ELEVON-TORSION-FOAM, CL-A-HORN-BEARING-STALL) as the basis of A-P13

nodes.title: Servo rail voltage under two-servo load (M12)
nodes.procedure: Kakute servo rail set to 7.2 V and measured under load; below 6.0 V the servo fails the 1.5 factor

nodes.title: Weigh-in: foam block, printed parts, epoxy joint, lead strip, one servo, then the aircraft
nodes.procedure: BOARD QP-4 s1 and FIXES2 s9: >= 27.2 g of the 41.6 g EST cuts must be real; as-built <= 1.47 kg (D-190; the +-5 % window holds to 1.478 kg)

nodes.title: CG breadboard on a knife edge (M5, M6)
nodes.procedure: Measure CG and NP on the built aircraft; trim the pack +-10 mm in the tray slots; CG 20-26 mm, SM >= 5 %

nodes.title: Tap test: built cage and fin against the FE modes
nodes.procedure: TP-10b (TEST-PLAN-O4B.md): rule applied to the measured modes with pack and motors installed (T-085, D-236). Cage pitch mode 12-16 Hz, roll 21-43 Hz and fin f1 within +-20 % of FE, else re-tune (BOARD QP-4, STRUCTURES-R)

nodes.title: First tethered hover, IMU VIBE
nodes.procedure: IMU VIBE < 30 m/s2 in the first tethered hover (A-P10(d))

nodes.title: First cruise: roll rate and measured stall (M8 extended)
nodes.procedure: Measure the peak roll rate (>= 90 deg/s) and the clean stall; the measured CLmax replaces 0.75

nodes.title: C3 time-domain pitch-over run at the as-weighed mass
nodes.procedure: MASS-GATE s1: above 1.486 kg the aircraft flies only if the run shows >= +-5 % at the as-weighed mass

nodes.title: Tethered hover, heading hold, vane off, light turbulence (M9)
nodes.procedure: BOARD QP-4 s7: heading excursion > 15 deg imposes the 4 m/s card; log motor output (peak <= 0.85)
